name: every-tracked-file-graphed-spine-narrowing
body: `requirements.requirement.every-tracked-file-graphed` drives `domain.group.structural-file-graphing`, which is `realised-by` `solution.container.structural-scanner`. `domain.entity.source-file` is `realised-by` `solution.component.identity-layer`, whose `implemented-by` set is `rust.apg.git`, `rust.apg.git.identity.repo_rel`, `rust.apg.ingest`, `rust.apg.ingest.identity.root_module_fqn`, `rust.apg.load`, and `rust.apg.load.export.write_graph_jsonl`. `requirements.requirement.repo-relative-file-identity` and `requirements.requirement.portable-graph-identity` drive `domain.entity.source-file`.
